'''Stron''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Posted in the [[Network Security District|Central Hub Prime]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he hired an Imperial to neutralize a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] code-named [[Zero (droid)|Zero]].<ref name="TOR" />
